If poor sleep persists, I noted it may be worth discussing with a healthcare professional.

For dinner you requested a vegetarian recipe featuring sweet potatoes and black beans; I crafted a quick roasted sweet potato and black bean burrito bowl suggestion. Additionally, I successfully added the demo items to your notes and set all reminders as requested.

Overall, the day was productive despite sleep challenges, with clear action items in place for both work and personal well‑being. You also reflected briefly on tension from poor sleep and hunching over the laptop, noting a small win in getting the export button working and merged into the codebase.

Your neck and shoulders remain tense, likely from inadequate rest and prolonged computer use—perhaps consider incorporating more movement breaks throughout the day to alleviate this discomfort. If you’d like further assistance with meal prep or additional reminders, just let me know!
